title: The Patch Press
tagline: Thai-language tech and open-source news dashboard in a comic-newspaper style, compiled automatically from GitHub and Hacker News.
summary: A Thai-language dashboard of AI, open-source and developer-tools news laid out like a comic newspaper, with category filters, search and a time-range selector. The page says its items are compiled automatically from GitHub and Hacker News, are not editor-verified analysis, and link back to the source. Per the owner it is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript plus one serverless function. The source repository is private and was not read; this entry rests on the public site and owner-supplied facts.

aiRole.summary: The source repository is private and was not inspected, so whether AI tooling was used to build the site is not known. The public page covers AI news as a topic only.
